questions.q: Work out (6 × 10⁵) × (4 × 10⁻²), giving your answer in standard form.
a = 12 and b = 4, both correct to the nearest whole number. Which gives the upper bound of a ÷ b?
questions.why: For the largest quotient, divide the upper bound of a by the lower bound of b.

questions.q: $5000 is invested at 3% per year compound interest. Find its value after 2 years.
questions.why: 5000 × 1.03² = 5304.50; $5300 is simple interest and $304.50 is only the interest.
